## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The invitation password validator should also enforce the new twelve-character minimum. It still accepts eight-character passwords, leaving the requirement incomplete.

## Critical

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — An eight-character password such as `"xxxxxxxx"` still passes the invitation validator despite the new twelve-character requirement. The stale minimum in `app/invite.py:1` remains eight, and `tests/test_invite.py:8` explicitly expects that behavior. Update the invitation minimum and its boundary tests alongside signup and reset. — Users taking the invitation path can still choose passwords shorter than the stated requirement.
